name: engineer-mission
userConfirmed: 2026-10-18 final requirements: four-scene silent film, continuous follow camera and animated official-rule minimap. Opening translates without spinning. Silver is stored and retrieved from above. Preserve the user-confirmed rendered stair elbow/housing direction and original negative-elbow gold retrieval. Stair preparation is cloud rearward, then arm J0 rearward, then fold arm J2 (source q1/q2/q3 use the user arm-zero-based numbering, independent cloud is source q0); arm J1 movement is modest. Keep rear wrist wheels loaded on the original flat ground until all four swerve wheels reach the second ledge, with the chassis level and all original structure retained. After gold withdrawal use a low carry, clear stored silver and keep the actual VT03 camera horizontal forward; normal driving retains fixed arm J1 and camera follows travel direction. Faster travel and combat spin, gradual spin stop after escape, acceleration/braking compression, rule-position road ribs and gain-zone paint. Blue surface-only vehicle/station strips, bright original field lights, complete bases and energy mechanism. First station target begins only after the robot parks; clear the arm before station recovery and gravity drop to the rear bin. Hide the two long rear VT03 leads, preserving housing, lens and mounting structure. Remove TCP trace and meaningless wrist-roll half-turns.
story: Depart without gyro spin. Retrieve both silver ores, lift clear, move above each rear cup and press downward. Prepare stairs sequentially: cloud, arm base, elbow. Front rack reaches each ledge before two level chassis lifts; rear wrist wheels support the original flat lower ground until all four main wheels reach the upper ledge, then rise and recover. Retrieve gold through the original side opening and lift45mm before withdrawing on the original elbow branch. Tuck gold low clear of both rear silver ores and level the actual camera optical axis. Late scattered gunfire, predictive per-shot aim and CAD ricochets; counter-rotate the upper assembly during fast chassis spin. Return via the open northern ramps, up to2.4m/s, brake at corners and targets, with four-wheel road-rib response and camera along velocity. Park before the initially forward blue exchange station moves to its first legal level4 receiving pose. Approach from outside the slot roof, insert, release and withdraw before recovery. Tip each ore over the rear collection bin and let it fall under gravity. Retain one silver and finish with the camera horizontal forward.

production.build: python scripts/extract-mission-field.py; python scripts/extract-mission-field.py --energy; python scripts/extract-mission-field.py --bases; python scripts/extract-mission-field.py --lights; python scripts/extract-mission-field.py --markings; python scripts/extract-mission-field.py --bump-arrows; python scripts/bake-mission-return.py; python scripts/extract-mission-lights.py; python scripts/extract-mission-transmitter.py; node scripts/build-engineer-mission.mjs
production.format: 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264, yuv420p, faststart, no audio stream
production.capture: 2609 individually authored WebGL frames per language with canvas HUD and WebCodecs H.264; constant30fps, no audio stream.
production.collision: scripts/mission-geometry.mjs loads the actual original robot, VT03, ore and station CAD triangles. SAH BVH prefilters only degenerate faces below the original1e-10m2 area predicate. Separate stair/carry/exchange sweep reports and rendered frame review; not a calibrated rigid-body simulation.

lights.armour: Actual LED surfaces, engineer_tagged.glb nodes 4/9/18/263 primitive 2, attached to chassis.
lights.upper: Node 1422: 272 mm connected diffuser identified by geometry, attached to J0. Housing retains the original material family.
lights.colour: Vehicle and station strips bright blue#5acaff, surface-only MeshBasicMaterial with toneMapping disabled; no point lamps, bloom or blue spill onto the chassis.
lights.field: 23 original thin lamp meshes, plus true coloured lamp faces of road/terrain. Gain-zone boundaries and public-road screen-print meshes777/778/1293/1294 are matte pale paint, not LEDs. Vehicle/station blue remains surface-only with no bloom or spill.

field.style: One persistent official-CAD field frame W=(-source Z,source Y,source X)/1000. Existing uncut terrain and existing detailed resource/station GLBs; dark fills and complete amber construction edges. Station housing fills are translucent to explain rear collection, retaining all original edges.
field.steps: A-specific two-riser sequence, preserving the user-confirmed shot-24_766667-zh.jpg elbow/housing orientation. Independent cloud turns rearward first; source arm waist q1 then turns rearward; source elbow q3 folds last while shoulder q2 preparation spans about37.7deg. Source q3=-265deg represents the physical+95deg support branch; support unfolding uses opposite elbow/wrist half-turns, no gratuitous wrist roll. Front support reaches beyond the first.64 and second1.105 metre step-local ledges before level chassis lifts. Body advances to step-localZ1.300; the four main contact points are then beyond the upper edge. Until then the rear wrist centre staysY.043 over original lower groundY.003, supported by its40mm wheels. Rear wrist lifts only after all four mains are on the upper plateau, then recovers. Exact kinematic, full-model terrain/self/cargo sweeps and rendered review are separate checks. This is distinct from the B-chapter single-step explanation; loads and timing remain illustrative.
field.goldRetrieval: Approach the middle channel from the blue (-Z) side. Contact the vertical ore face, lift the ore 45 mm inside the glass-covered channel, withdraw horizontally, then retract outside the opening. Reference geometry checks cover the real ore hull and field triangles.
field.station: Original complete exchange-station.glb copied to official blue-side position with blue team strips. True base yaw, shoulder/forearm parallelograms, terminal yaw, roll and pitch. Receiving normals point slightly beyond sideways. Release and clear the manipulator before station recovery. The station carries each ore above a rear-side collector, then tips; ore follows gravity after clearing the slot, never slides through the back of a stationary slot.
field.stationRules: Rule pp87–89,91–93: level-4 receiving targets x[-270,0],y[-255,255],z[720,900]mm, x^2+y^2+(z-600)^2<=90000; theta[-135,135],phi(0,90],alpha[-45,45]; complete slot remains behind front-board plane. Two ores at distinct target poses; station moving time excluded. Check A/B targets and actual full-mesh clearance separately from recovery motion.
field.map: Rule page37 native figure, operator-POV orientation. Crop(231,227,795,438), physical28x15m interior(241.5,238,773,414); robot marker and route derive from the same actual W position as the 3D vehicle, with blue station upper right. Dynamic short fading wake, flowing look-ahead guidance, pulsing destination, live direction cone and action label; no permanent full-mission polyline.
field.route: Leave the highland through the open northern wide 10.666-degree CAD slope to the .203m road shelf (manual nominal10.5 degrees). Follow the shelf east, then the open10-degree blue-side ramp back to the main floor. Circle back to the blue exchange station. Do not use the 550mm-wide,450mm-high side tunnel or pass through its frame. Chassis spin settles before the return slope.
field.stationAxes: Terminal yaw from CAD815 57 mm circular flange [0,*,-.3293916606] along Y, output nodes841/842/971. Shoulder805 and811 endpoints both760 mm, second parallel pair810/812; actual roll and pitch retained. Empty CAD980 origin is not a pivot.

stationRecovery.evidenceBoundary: Original complete source meshes/pivots. CAD844 rear roll casing stays with wristYaw, not roll output. Source joint recovery paths were checked independently from receiving-pose constraints; actual ore hull and internal bin ledge are included. Obscured footage does not measure exact dumping angles.

returnBake.method: Arc-length travel <=2.4m/s, acceleration2.3m/s2, braking5.5m/s2, corner lateral limit1.8m/s2. Four-wheel 11.2mm source-position rib contact, filtered road heave/pitch/roll and separate load transfer at120Hz.

field.silverGrasp: Per-ore original top-pickup grip is solved once and retained through transfer. The main cup faces down and presses vertically onto each rear cup; a small, purposeful roll squares the stored cube. After an overhead approach, a clear side face is regrasped and lifted vertically so its original barcode face remains down when inserted beneath the closed station roof. Source grasps and stored rotations are recorded in grasps.json.
field.goldGrasp: Middle gold ore begins at GOLD_PROP rotation Ry(-135), matching the original assembly. Side suction uses identity grasp offset; barcode-Y points toward slot-Y at placement.

suspension.method: Small illustrative sprung-body load transfer:4Hz, damping0.68, pitch/roll response0.0045rad per m/s2, heave0.55mm per m/s2, separated from the terrain-following wheel frame. Chassis remains level on the stair sequence.
suspension.evidenceBoundary: Not a measured spring/damper model or a calibrated full rigid-body simulation.
suspension.road: Four independently sampled wheel elevations;17-point circular tyre envelope.6Hz damping0.58 illustrative sprung response to actual ribs, separate from acceleration/braking compression. Chassis remains level on stairs.

energy.rotation: Both five-arm sides share one physical axis at pi/3rad/s, per small-energy rulep105. Pillars and suspension remain fixed. Single active fan per team is an illustrative background state.

bases.lights: Original outer-armour diffusers1453/1471/1489 and2324/2342/2360 in their red/blue field halves.

markings.style: Original CAD floor silk-screen/gain-zone paint triangles, non-emissive pale grey; no glow or lamp substitution.

bumps.source: Original CAD arrow footprints; straight rib bands traced from the rule figure and clipped to the original highland plateau. Four-wheel circular contact envelopes use the same rib height profile as the visible geometry.

transmitter.policy: Original CAD tessellation/materials; two whole rear lead feature groups hidden by default. Housing, fins, lens, mounting ears and short housing-side ports unchanged. No proxy or decimation.

cameraOpticalAxis.evidence: Source301 front15mm lens component firstFace170393. Its447 near-axis front-face triangles, beginning170633, have area-weighted native normal[-.999999949,.000145222,.000000765]. Lens symmetry gives nominal native-X optical axis, opposite rear leads. This differs from tool suction normal.

stationInitial.condition: Robot has parked before first motion; full native station meshes checked throughout the transition.

boundary: Combined mission and projectile attack are an authored functional scenario. Stair stage order comes from sequential real-robot demonstration frames; exact joints, lift stroke, loads, chassis speed and dump trajectory are illustrative, not calibrated dynamics or one match replay. Rule geometry and receiving constraints are verified independently. Source CAD stays read only.
camera: Closer continuous follow framing prioritizes the robot, tool contact and ore hand-offs. Complete source props remain in world space and may be partly outside the frame. Filming camera follows the base terrain pose so rib-induced heave/pitch/roll remains visible. The actual robot VT03 optical axis is derived from its original source lens and controlled independently of the suction-cup normal: horizontal and along return velocity, including banked road and chassis spin. Minimap shares the retimed chassis clock.

projectiles.aim: Recompute a ballistic leading aim for every shot; no in-flight homing.
projectiles.contacts: Actual CAD triangle surface points/normals, including moving-surface velocity. Normal restitution0.46, tangential retention0.75. Impact rings and short traces visualize contact.
projectiles.evidenceBoundary: Authored illustrative parameters, not measured material coefficients or a replay of a specific firefight.
